text:
Everything in your vault is encrypted with AES-256, the standard banks and governments use. Your encryption key comes from your master password through PBKDF2 with 600,000 iterations. That makes every password guess slow and expensive for an attacker, even one with powerful hardware.

Your master password never leaves your device, and our servers never see it. We store only encrypted data in the cloud, and only you hold the key to unlock it. Someone who broke into our servers would find nothing they could use. You can still get to your passwords from any of your devices.
